relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: facilitates the targeted breakdown of CSPGs and the disruption of perineuronal nets (PNNs)

relationships.subject: HIF-1
relationships.evidence_quote: aberrant activation of transcription factors like HIF-1 and NF-κB strongly upregulates the expression of MMPs (e.g., MMP-9, MMP-2, MMP-3) and ADAMTS

relationships.subject: TIMPs
relationships.evidence_quote: This proteolytic activity is tightly counterregulated by tissue inhibitors of metalloproteinases (TIMPs), which neutralize MMPs to prevent unconstrained matrix destruction

relationships.subject: Tenascin-R
relationships.evidence_quote: Tenascin-R (TnR) plays a key structural role in the perineuronal nets (PNNs) of the mature brain; where it supports the assembly and stabilization of aggrecan-rich ECM

key_findings: Review frames brain ECM remodeling via PNN-interneuron-plasticity, glial-ECM-inflammation and ECM-vascular-BBB axes
MMPs from microglia and astrocytes degrade CSPGs and PNNs; HIF-1/NF-kB drive MMP upregulation in pain and inflammation, counterbalanced by TIMPs
